# contract-mock-server

> Mock HTTP server from consumer contract files: request matching with path templates, query, headers and JSON subset bodies, mismatch reports and unused checks Python package `trysac-contract-mock-server`, import name `contract_mock_server`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
